EXAMPLE FAMILY HEALTH PLAN — POLICY WORDING (Version 01)
UIN: EXAHLIP26001V012526

Section 9. General Terms and Clauses

9.1 Entire Contract
The proposal form, the Schedule, this Policy Wording and any Endorsements issued shall be read together as one contract.

9.2 Construction and Order of Precedence
In case of any conflict between the Policy Wording and the Schedule, the Schedule shall prevail. Any Endorsement shall prevail over both the Schedule and the Policy Wording to the extent of the change it records. In case of any conflict between a translation and the English version, the English version shall prevail.

9.3 Add-on Covers
Each Add-on Cover is a separate contract issued along with this Policy and is governed by its own Add-on wording, premium and terms. The Example Hospital Daily Cash Add-on has its own waiting period of 30 days from the first inception of the Add-on. Exclusions of this Policy shall apply to the Add-on unless the Add-on wording states otherwise. An Add-on cannot be continued without the base Policy.

9.4 Claims Administration
Claims under this Policy shall be serviced by the Third Party Administrator (TPA) named in the Schedule. The admissibility of a claim shall be decided by the Company.
